messages:
anya (PM): Heads-up: customer Y asked for per-tenant pin grace windows and a non-blocking migration summary. We need a minimal spec to ship this week.
tariq (Eng): quick sketch: per-tenant pin TTL + optional 'grace_mode' where we still route to new model but add shim transforms for fields that changed. Grace_mode should be reversible per-tenant.
rachel (SRE): ops constraints: must not increase global p95 by >30ms. Add circuit-breaker: if cohort error_rate increases by 0.4% for 10m pause routing. Also want metric tags tenant_id, pin_state.
diego (CS): customers want a visible expiry and opt-in audit log. Also a CSV export of current pins and TTLs. Can we show "expected retirement date" in console?
anya (PM): acceptance criteria proposal (minimal): 1) API to set pin with ttl and grace_mode flag, 2) console shows pin expiry, 3) audit-log entry for pin/unpin, 4) rollback if embed_cos_drop > 0.07 or error_rate delta > 0.5%.
tariq (Eng): API proto: POST /v1/catalog/pins {tenant_id, model_id, ttl_days, grace_mode:boolean} and GET /v1/catalog/pins?tenant_id=. Wire to feature-flag service.
ops-bot: scheduled job: nightly pin_export -> s3://redwood-exports/pins/customerY/ at 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.
rachel (SRE): I'll add dashboard: p95_by_tenant, embed_cosine_shift_by_tenant, pin_state_counts. I'll also add an alert: if >5 tenants tripping rollback in 1h -> page #infra.
diego (CS): one more ask: enable a per-tenant "soft-extend" button for CS to add +30d to TTL without contacting engineering.
tariq (Eng): doable: admin API `POST /admin/pins/extend {tenant_id, days}` with audit. I'll add RBAC check.
anya (PM): timeline: prototype API + console copy by EOD Fri, SRE dashboards + alerts next week, include in runbook. Meeting Friday 9am to review demo.
